prompt:
Pixel-art character turnaround sheet for a monster in a Doom/Hexen-style first-person dark-fantasy dungeon game, where monsters are drawn as sprites seen from several camera angles: the OGRE, a hulking brute half again as tall as a man, which leaps across rooms at the player and smashes the floor with a huge stone maul.

REFERENCE IMAGES, in the order attached: turnaround sheets of four other monsters from the same game (a red imp, a hooded robed acolyte, an armoured knight, and a winged harpy). Use them ONLY for the art style and the sheet layout: pixel size, outline weight, shading, how the views are arranged and how far each one is turned. Do not copy anything of their designs. In particular the ogre must NOT look like the knight: no plate armour, no helm, no shield, no runes.

THE OGRE
- A HUGE, HULKING brute, hunched forward under its own weight, far bigger and much BROADER than the knight: massive rounded shoulders, a barrel chest, a heavy gut, arms thick as tree trunks hanging to its knees, short bowed legs like pillars, broad bare feet with thick yellowed toenails. Its body is about as wide as it is tall.
- A SMALL HEAD for its size, set LOW and forward between the shoulders, with no neck to speak of: a heavy, jutting underbite JAW with two thick, chipped yellow TUSKS curving up from the lower lip, a flat broad nose, a thick brow ridge, small ragged ears, a few strands of lank black hair. Deep under the brow, one TINY GLINTING EYE on each side, a single pale yellow pixel or two.
- Thick, warty GREY-GREEN HIDE, darker and mottled on the back and shoulders, paler on the gut, with old scars.
- Crude gear: thick IRON BANDS riveted round both wrists and one round the upper left arm, a heavy iron collar-chain hanging across the chest; a loincloth and belt of ragged, stitched HIDE WRAPPINGS in dirty brown, strips of hide wound round the shins and the right forearm.
- A two-handed STONE MAUL: a big rough-hewn block of grey stone as large as the ogre's head, lashed and bound with iron bands onto a thick wooden HAFT, itself bound with iron rings. In the standing pose the ogre grips the haft in its RIGHT hand near the top, and the stone head rests on the ground beside its right foot. The LEFT hand hangs empty, its fingers thick and curled.
- An earthy, brutish palette, unlike the imp's red, the acolyte's oxblood and fire, the knight's steel and blue runes or the harpy's dusty browns: grey-green hide, dirty brown hide wrappings, dull rusty iron, grey stone, yellowed tusks; pale yellow only for the eyes.

LAYOUT
- One horizontal row of 5 equal cells, read left to right: FRONT (facing the viewer), FRONT THREE-QUARTER, SIDE (profile), REAR THREE-QUARTER, BACK (facing away).
- In the front three-quarter, side and rear three-quarter views the ogre faces IMAGE-LEFT.
- The maul stays in the same hand (the right) in every view, so it is on the opposite side of the body in the front and back views: on the image-left side in the front view, on the image-right side in the back view.
- The same figure at the same scale in every cell, standing on the same ground line, in the same pose; only the camera angle changes.
- Background: flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, with no gradient, texture, vignette, glow, cast shadow or floor.
- The cells are separated by thin vertical lines of pure cyan (#00FFFF), each running the full height of the image.
- The whole figure, including the maul and both shoulders, fits inside each cell with a clear magenta margin. Nothing touches a cell edge or a cyan line, and nothing is cropped.
- No text, labels, numbers, frame borders, dust, smoke or effects outside the figure.
- Crisp pixel art with hard edges and no anti-aliasing against the magenta. No semi-transparent pixels, and no pink or purple glow bleeding into the background.
